agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review mutates no formal state/code and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only in v2.1 and must not become verified Experience merely by aggregation.
Strict bool validation is useful type hardening but is not evidence of freshness, authority provenance, verifier authority or replay resistance.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and should remain observational until independently derived and tested against self-reinforcement.
The v2.1 contract correctly keeps speed improvement NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: New primary objection on current exact bytes: proposed_autonomy is validated as integer 0..6, but v1 only applies the cap when proposed_autonomy > 0 and then forces the final normal gear to at least G2 via max(2,...). Consequently proposed_autonomy=0 does not cap routing at zero/standby and proposed_autonomy=1 can still return G2. v2 and v2.1 inherit this behavior. The candidate therefore cannot claim proposed_autonomy is an enforced maximum autonomy/gear authority boundary.
disagreements.required_change: Define the exact semantics of autonomy values 0 and 1 and enforce them at one canonical control boundary. If 0 means no autonomous execution it must map to N or another explicit nonexecuting state; if 1 means maximum G1 it must never return G2+. If the field is not an authority cap, rename/recontract it so callers cannot rely on a false safety guarantee. Preserve the historical v1 VERIFIED_PASS as baseline; this veto bounds v2/v2.1 adoption claims and does not retroactively invalidate formal history.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events parses independently_verified before checking whether event_id is already in seen. A replay that should be exactly-once NO_OP can reuse an already-seen event_id but supply malformed verifier metadata and raise GearboxGuardError before duplicate detection, aborting the batch and censoring later valid evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Canonicalize and authenticate event identity/binding before verifier parsing. Exact accepted replay is deterministic NO_OP; same ID with different binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; malformed duplicate cannot abort later independent records.

disagreements.finding: v2 can deny real Experience outside canonical C_VERIFIED while v2.1 independently recomputes positive verified_experience_delta from raw caller event_kind plus event_independently_verified.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must consume one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt or exact inherited verification eligibility result bound to evidence, trusted C/independent-verifier identity, mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and runtime/install identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted source, freshness, scope and policy metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed; neutralizing secretary alone is not proof that fresh authority won.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from a precommitted denominator/window and tested against self-reinforcement.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay NO_OP, same-evidence/new-ID lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt in the executable authority path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: Operational progress is still granted from caller-supplied event_id/event_kind without durable artifact or defect acceptance proof.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe; raw claims yield zero authoritative operational credit.

disagreements.finding: v1 can return trusted R rollback or N standby, but v2 recovery/anchor/RED-secretary overlays can overwrite selected with G1 before v2.1 sees the terminal state.
disagreements.required_change: Give terminal states structural precedence across v1->v2->v2.1; R cannot be overwritten by secretary/pressure/recovery heuristics and N exits only through explicit trusted precedence.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: A nominal autonomy cap that is ignored at 0 or floored to G2 at 1 can confound safety/performance comparisons because test arms may not actually run under the requested autonomy ceiling.
Duplicate replay parser-order DoS can censor later valid evidence based on batch ordering, biasing acceptance and latency statistics.
Dropping inherited verification eligibility can inflate longitudinal verified-Experience totals with events that v2 marks NOT_PROMOTION_EVIDENCE.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if policy-created progress is fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Caller-created operational events can inflate durable-progress numerator without proof of durable work.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-PROPOSED-AUTONOMY-CAP-140: under otherwise permissive inputs, proposed_autonomy=0 and proposed_autonomy=1 must follow the precommitted authority semantics; if defined as a cap they must never return a gear above that cap.

GB21-PROPOSED-AUTONOMY-CROSSPATH-141: v1, v2 and v2.1 must expose the same canonical autonomy-limit semantics for values 0..6; wrapper layers may tighten but may not silently weaken the requested ceiling.
GB21-DUPLICATE-REPLAY-PARSE-136/137 plus cross-run replay and same-evidence/new-ID lineage tests remain required.
GB21-INHERITED-EXPERIENCE-GATE-133/134 and verification-metadata binding remain required.
Secretary freshness forge and exact AuthorityDecisionEnvelope projection tests remain required.
Shift-rate provenance, small-n, anti-thrash chatter/release and performance non-regression tests remain required.
Verified evidence without exact trusted verifier/C receipt must yield zero authoritative verified credit.
Operational progress without durable artifact/defect receipt must yield zero authoritative operational credit.

Paired speed baseline must use durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency under sealed matched workload and randomized/crossover order.

blocks: claim that proposed_autonomy currently enforces a strict maximum authority/gear ceiling
authoritative verified Experience accounting from current v2/v2.1 raw-field paths
authoritative operational-progress/speed numerator accounting from raw caller event fields
automatic authority escalation based on secretary/anti-thrash/progress heuristics
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

proposed_autonomy has a single documented canonical meaning across v1/v2/v2.1 and values 0/1 cannot silently result in a higher autonomous gear than the declared ceiling; if it is not an authority ceiling the API/contract is renamed so that no safety claim depends on it.

Duplicate/exact replay handling occurs before mutable verifier parsing or is resolved by a durable accepted-event registry: exact replay is deterministic NO_OP, same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT, malformed replay cannot censor later independent evidence.

Every authoritative verified delta comes only from an immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt bound to exact evidence and trusted C/independent-verifier identity; v2.1 cannot re-mint verified credit from raw caller fields.
Operational progress remains non-Experience but every authoritative operational credit is evidence-bound to a durable artifact/defect acceptance receipt with lineage dedupe.
Secretary freshness and authority conflict are evidence-bound to trusted replay-resistant envelopes, with the actual fresh authority decision projected.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and hysteretic release; anti-thrash passes performance non-regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and proven non-self-reinforcing.
Terminal-state precedence is structurally defined and tested: trusted R cannot be overwritten by secretary/pressure/recovery heuristics; N exits only through explicit trusted precedence rules.
5/4/3/1 credit weights remain heuristic analytics and never serve as capability, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance or promotion truth.

Speedup claim remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED until sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evaluation shows improvement in durable_progress_per_wake and verified_closure_per_hour with non-inferior cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency, verification quality and risk under frozen metric definitions and complete assigned-workload coverage.
